claims.citation: New York Herald, 24 May 1866, p. 5, col. 6
claims.verbatim:
ST MICHAEL'S, April 30[?]—The Ephesus (s), Collings, from
Liverpool for Boston, 15 days, put in here to repair steam
pipe, which had burst. She reported having encountered
strong westerly gales, and labored heavily.

claims.citation: New York Herald, 24 May 1866, p. 5, col. 6
claims.verbatim:
but on the following day she put back, and land-
ed a seaman who had fallen from the mast and was seri-
ously injured. The master reports a heavy westerly sea
outside, and the vessel making water, and the pumps not
working well. He ordered off laborers to pump her out, and
is endeavoring to find the leak to enable her to proceed if
possible.
